name: See3CAM_CU30_CHL_L_TH_BX
notes: This exact suffix isn't in e-con's public catalog, but it clearly belongs to the See3CAM_CU30 family; values below are the family's.
The suffix L_TH_BX may encode a lens/enclosure configuration. The focal length is deliberately not inferred from it.
The AR0330-based CU30 was used by Xilinx with the Zynq UltraScale+ reVISION stack, which is likely why this unit came with the ZCU104/Zynq hardware.

sensor.shutter: electronic rolling shutter; global-reset capability requires appropriate firmware/configuration
sensor.spectral: Good near-infrared responsivity; suitable for day/night/NIR configurations.
